_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil persists with only 5% of 12h windows showing ±2+ point moves, and with the analyst's 18.8% direction accuracy demanding base-rate respect, HOLD is the statistically honest call until either ETF flows turn positive or BTC breaks below $60k with funding spiking.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction citing pre-capitulation risk; narrative implies upward resolution toward Disbelief/Hope based on the August 2024 analog; the split is unresolved and the analyst's higher trust weight plus stronger internal-metric evidence carries the consensus.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows turn positive and stablecoin growth recovers above 45 with BTC holding $62k+, which would validate the narrative's accumulation framing and shift phase toward Disbelief
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC breaks below $60k with funding spiking above 0.015% and VIX pushing 20+, which would confirm the analyst's pre-capitulation distribution read and drop the phase toward Panic
